2609.01519.title: When Guardrails Look Effective: Construct Validity Failures in LLM Agent Commerce Evaluation
2609.01519.paper_summary: Interactive simulations increasingly evaluate policies in markets populated by language-model agents. Their outputs can look economic---prices, profits, consumer surplus, and welfare---without instantiating the behavior named in the claim. We audit this risk in a multi-turn buyer--seller testbed for configurable hotel transactions. An initial implementation reported welfare gains from two marketplace guardrails of +87.4, +35.0, and +28.8 across a Qwen2.5 1.5B--14B ladder. It also gave guarded and unguarded agents different offer schemas and choice procedures. Holding the schema and buyer chooser fixed changes the paired contrasts to +7.2, -13.9, and +23.8. The four largest 14B single-generation effects averaged +229; after three generations per profile-condition, they averaged +37.6 (95% bootstrap interval [-34.2, 109.3]), while generation residuals account for 49.9% of variation in this post-hoc probe. A seller-incentive check is non-monotone: increasing profit pressure produces less profit than the default seller prompt. Scripted positive controls show why this matters. A profit-maximizing seller already attains first-best welfare, so guardrails mostly redistribute and reduce welfare; they create welfare only when the seller is explicitly programmed to force inefficient bundles. We contribute a construct-validity contract separating incentive validity, protocol isolation, stochastic stability, and welfare accounting, and returning INVALID or INCONCLUSIVE before substantive policy claims. In our case, the original estimate is INVALID under protocol isolation, while the controlled study remains INCONCLUSIVE under incentive validity and stochastic stability. The case does not show that guardrails are ineffective; it shows their apparent value is unidentified until the simulated agents and protocol pass these checks.
2609.01519.paper_summary_zh: 互動模擬越來越多地評估由語言模型代理組成的市場中的政策。它們的輸出看起來像是經濟數據——價格、利潤、消費者剩餘和福利——卻並未實現聲稱中的行為。我們在一個可配置酒店交易的多回合買賣測試平台中審核這一風險。初步實施報告了來自兩個市場護欄的福利增益，分別為 +87.4、+35.0 和 +28.8，這些數據來自 Qwen2.5 1.5B--14B 的階梯。它還給予了有護欄和無護欄的代理不同的報價模式和選擇程序。固定模式和買方選擇者的情況下，配對對比變為 +7.2、-13.9 和 +23.8。四個最大的 14B 單次生成效應平均為 +229；在每個配置條件下經過三代後，它們的平均值為 +37.6（95% 自助法區間 [-34.2, 109.3]），而生成殘差解釋了這次後驗探查中 49.9% 的變異。賣方激勵檢查是非單調的：增加利潤壓力產生的利潤低於默認的賣方提示。腳本化的正控制顯示了這一點的重要性。一個利潤最大化的賣方已經達到了最佳福利，因此護欄主要是重新分配並減少福利；只有當賣方被明確編程以強迫無效的捆綁時，它們才會創造福利。我們貢獻了一個構造有效性的合約，將激勵有效性、協議隔離、隨機穩定性和福利會計分開，並在實質政策主張之前返回 INVALID 或 INCONCLUSIVE。在我們的案例中，原始估計在協議隔離下是 INVALID，而受控研究在激勵有效性和隨機穩定性下仍然是 INCONCLUSIVE。該案例並未顯示護欄無效；它顯示出其表面價值在模擬代理和協議通過這些檢查之前是未被識別的。
2609.01519.author: Peiying Zhu et.al.
